version.description: Schema version of this rules file.

file.description: Path(s) to the file(s) this rule inspects. Accepts a single string or an array of strings.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what this rule detects.

filetype.description: Force a specific parser. If omitted the extension of 'file' is used; unknown extensions fall back to plain text. 'binary' loads raw bytes; 'text' loads UTF-8 string; 'json' parses as JSON.

patterns.description: Pattern or list of patterns to evaluate against the file content. A list is treated as an implicit AND.

actions.description: Actions to apply to the file when this rule matches. Text files support delete/replace/add; JSON files support replace only.

code.description: Path to a Python file relative to the rules directory. The file must expose a handler(filename, match) function that is called when this rule matches. Cannot traverse outside the rules directory.

patternNode.description: A single pattern node. Exactly one key must be present.

jq.description: A jq expression evaluated against the parsed file content. Matches when the result is truthy.

contains.description: Matches when the content contains this value. For strings: substring check. For arrays/objects: membership check.

equals.description: Matches when the content is strictly equal to this value.

not-equals.description: Matches when the content is not strictly equal to this value.

not-contains.description: Matches when the content does not contain this value. Mirror of 'contains'.

match.description: A Python regex (re.search) applied to the string representation of the content. Matches when found; matched_content is set to the matched substring.

or.description: Matches when at least one sub-pattern matches.

exists.description: Matches when the file exists on disk. Takes no value.

not-exists.description: Matches when the file does not exist on disk. Takes no value.

actionNode.description: A single action node. Exactly one key must be present.

delete.description: Text only. Removes all occurrences of the matched content from the file.

replace.description: Text: replaces matched content with the given string. JSON: replaces file content via 'str' (raw JSON string) or 'jq' (jq expression).

oneOf.description: Replacement string (text files). Use an empty string or null to replace with nothing.
JSON replacement. Provide exactly one of 'str' or 'jq'.

str.description: A JSON string to write as the new file content.

jq.description: A jq expression applied to the current file content. The result is written back as JSON.

add.description: Text only. Appends the given string at the end of the file.

delete-file.description: Deletes the matched file from disk. Takes no value.
